# Kite Developer Docs

> Kite is agentic payment infrastructure. Kite Agent Passport gives AI agents identity, delegated payment authority, and onchain settlement.

## Endpoints

- Sharded full content (per collection):
  - https://docs.gokite.ai/llms/docs.txt
  - https://docs.gokite.ai/llms/changelog.txt
  - https://docs.gokite.ai/llms/api-reference.txt
  - https://docs.gokite.ai/llms/blog.txt
- Full corpus (capped at 2 MiB): https://docs.gokite.ai/llms-full.txt
- MCP server (read-only): https://docs.gokite.ai/mcp
- Sitemap: https://docs.gokite.ai/sitemap.xml
